reviews.rationale: Whole-unit HOLD. I completed actual selected-page, Table I, full Latin-entry/continuation and photographed grammar controls, preserving the candidate-unopened freeze and all candidate-exposed corrections. Actual photo rechecks resolve my own finite/participle and nominative-suffix mistakes toward the selected active ከሠተ and nominative possessive ጥበቡ; this is exposed correction, not blind prior agreement. The wisdom-as-subject construction is supported, as are the actors, objects, suffixes, non-negated hate/reject predicates, preservation/share, and plural be-saved clause. Nevertheless I cannot independently certify the precise eventive English brought revelation as positively established rather than a paraphrastic repair of a transitive active with no overt object, nor have I independently fixed the implicit singular subject/referent of final ኮነ. The candidate final it was for their life is admirably bounded and does not delete le, but a deliberately non-named subject and note cannot turn my unresolved meaning check into a whole-verse acceptance. This is a reviewer evidentiary HOLD, not a claim that the selected source contains an unknown glyph, that all possible renderings are false, or that the candidate must be rewritten to my failed reading.

The name/own-name and salvation clauses remain intact. Final syntax retains l-life but I cannot independently certify its exact unexpressed subject.
